scheme_name: Scholarship/Merit Scholarship Schools SC/ST/OBC/Min (Studying in College/Technical/ Professional Institutions)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a student enrolled in a recognized school, college or institution in India.
The applicant must have secured at least 60% marks in the previous examination.
For OBC/Minority students, the annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000.
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarship of ₹420–₹1,860 payable for 12 months, amount varies by course group and hosteller/day scholar status.
